## Asset Category

`name`, `code`, `description`, `expectedLifeMonths`, `defaultCriticality` (Criticality field), `defaultTeamName`, `icon` (wind | forklift | flame | laptop | plug | boxes). Maintenance plans with no asset link to a category and act as templates; Raise Work Order reads `defaultTeamName` for routing.

### Consume
`@field category = linksTo(() => AssetCategory)`; use `categoryIcon(name)` from this module to render the pictogram.

### Second consumer
Any register of typed things — a vehicle fleet, a lab instrument list.

cardInfo.name: Asset Category
cardInfo.summary: A class of asset carrying the defaults every asset of that kind inherits — expected life, default criticality, maintaining team.
